recent_trades.summary: Initiating a 10% short position in Starbucks following its announcement of 250 imminent store closures.

This structural reduction in footprint directly impairs near-term revenue growth and provides a clean technical and fundamental short setup.

The stock itself is stable rather than overextended, and energy is one of the firmer groups intraday. I am increasing the weight, but only to 4%, because this is still an incremental fundamental build rather than a full-size conviction position.
